resources.string: Sign in with your Plex account to find your server automatically. Plex handles your password in its own page; account and server tokens stay encrypted on your phone.
Choose what you want to listen to. You can add or change libraries later in Settings.
Plex opens in your browser to approve this phone. We keep waiting here and continue to your server as soon as you approve it.
These servers are available to your Plex account.
Pick the Plex library containing your music. You can change it later in Settings.
Pick the Plex library containing your audiobooks. You can change it later in Settings.
After entering the code in Plex, return here. Plex does not provide an app redirect, but this screen will continue automatically once it is approved.
Use this only if account discovery is unavailable.
Signed in. Finding your Plex servers…
Plex signed in, but no accessible server was found.
Open plex.tv/link in your browser and enter the code shown here.
Enter both your Plex server address and token.
Your Plex login is saved. Could not find servers: %1$s. Tap Retry connection.
Enter this code at Plex Link, then return here. Your code stays saved while you switch apps.
Connection interrupted. Keeping your code and retrying automatically…
This Plex code expired. Tap Link with Plex for a new code.
Secure storage was reset. Sign in to Plex again.
Signed out. Downloads and listening history were kept on this phone.
None of this server\'s addresses responded. Check that the server is online, then retry.
The connection could not be saved.
Download saved titles to see them here offline.
Books you\'ve listened to will appear here, including finished titles.
Your five-star Plex albums appear here. Tap an album\'s heart to rate it five stars.
Choose a library in settings, or refresh your connection.
PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
Choose the Plex library for audiobooks. You only need to do this once.
Choose the Plex library for music. You only need to do this once.
Try a different title, artist or author.
Offline only: searching downloads on this phone
Only downloaded titles can be found while offline-only mode is on.
Choose another filter or refresh your library.
This artist has no downloaded albums.
Refresh your library or return to the artist list.
Download music albums to browse their artists offline.
Choose a music library in Settings or refresh your collection.
Plex progress changed somewhere else. Review it before automatic updates resume.
Your position is saved on this phone. Reconnect to compare with Plex.
Pause playback to compare saved positions.
Check your connection and retry this album.
New books play at this speed. A speed chosen in the player is saved for that book only, until you reset it.

After you pause a book for 30 seconds or more, or a call, another app or disconnected headphones interrupt it, playback resumes a little earlier. It never goes back past the start of the current chapter, and seeking or choosing a chapter while paused cancels it.
Player could not connect. Reopen the app to retry.
Playback interrupted. Check your connection, then press play to retry.
This download is incomplete. Reconnect and finish downloading before playing offline.
Download this title before resuming it offline.
This title isn\'t downloaded. Connect to Plex to download it.
Showing the last saved list. Plex couldn\'t refresh it, so it may be out of date.
Only browse and play downloaded files. Your phone\'s connection stays unchanged.
Downloads run over Wi-Fi, including while the app is closed. A title is ready when every track or chapter is saved.
Open an album or audiobook and tap the circular down-arrow to save it offline. It will appear here when queued.
Saving offline. Tap to cancel download
Remove %1$s from this phone? Playback of this title will stop. Your Plex files and saved listening position stay unchanged; you can download it again.

resources.string: Couldn\'t queue every file. Completed downloads are safe; tap Retry download.
Couldn\'t remove the download. Please retry.
Couldn\'t read downloads. Check that phone storage is available.
Turn off offline mode to download more titles.
Removed this phone\'s download. The Plex original is unchanged.
Couldn\'t save download catalogue. Check phone storage.
Saved in Plex. To build a playlist, open an album and add tracks or the whole album.
Playlist editing needs a connection. Downloaded albums are in Downloads.
No music playlists yet. Add a track to create your first one.
Smart playlist · its rules are managed in Plex
Edits save to Plex. Press play again to use a changed order.
Delete %1$s? This removes the playlist from Plex on all your devices and stops it if playing on this phone. The music files and phone downloads stay untouched.
Remove %1$s from this playlist? The Plex original and any phone download stay untouched.
%1$s couldn\'t be confirmed. Refresh playlists before retrying to avoid adding duplicates.
Smart playlists are managed by Plex
Playlist may have been saved. Refresh playlists before trying again.
Changes are saved to Plex and locked there. Media files and artwork are not changed.
Plex could not save those metadata changes.
Enter a four-digit year, or leave it unchanged.
Album title and artist are required.
Plex could not find the edited album after saving.
Plex did not confirm every change. Refresh before trying again.
Couldn\'t confirm the Plex rating. Refresh your library before retrying.
Replace this chapter\'s Plex position (%1$s) with the phone position above? This can move it backwards. Other chapters and played flags are not explicitly changed.
Choose the saved Plex position to resume.
Choose a saved Plex chapter to resume. Multiple offsets can remain from earlier listening; none is assumed to be the latest.
Chapters shown are from the file\'s markers; Plex stores one position per file.
Plex has no resumable chapter offsets for this book.
Plex library setting: Store track progress must be enabled before Plex can retain this chapter or accept automatic updates.
Chapter position saved to Plex. Other chapters were not changed.
Pause playback and turn off offline-only mode to compare with Plex.
Couldn\'t read Plex progress. Your phone position is unchanged; reconnect and try again.
Pause playback and reconnect before exchanging positions.
Plex progress changed. Close this comparison and compare again.
This chapter changed. Refresh the book and compare again.
Playback or account changed. Pause and compare again.
Plex rejected the request (HTTP %1$d). Check the account\'s permissions.
Connection interrupted. The last request may have reached Plex; compare again before retrying. Your phone position is unchanged.
Plex progress changed. Compare again before sending your phone position.
Phone playback or account changed. Pause and compare again.
Plex did not confirm this position. Check Store track progress in the audiobook library, then compare again. Your phone position is unchanged.
Choose an audiobook, not a playlist.
Listen to this book on this phone first.
This position belongs to an earlier app version or connection. Play and pause this book to create an account-safe checkpoint.
Completed-book syncing is not available yet.
The saved chapter is missing or changed. Play and pause a chapter to save a new position.
This chapter has no valid resumable position.
This saved position belongs to another Plex server.

This forgets your Plex account, server and any sign-in code on this phone, and drops unsent audiobook progress. Downloads and listening history stay, but are read-only until the same account signs in again.
YOUR PLEX, TWO WAYS TO LISTEN
Choose a separate Plex library for each mode. Playback continues while you browse.
Your existing sign-in is saved on this phone
Sign out / forget this Plex account

Audiobook progress is saved on this phone. While a book plays, resumable checkpoints are recorded and sent to Plex automatically with a conflict check; chapters are never marked complete for you. Open a book and use Compare with Plex to review any conflicts. Download music or books for offline playback; downloads wait for Wi-Fi.
Player controls are for this device
Send the current track to a speaker on your home network. Whole-album queues and remote playback controls aren\'t supported yet.
No speakers discovered. Add a home IP below to connect directly over VPN.
Saved addresses bypass automatic discovery. Your VPN must route to the home network, and the speaker must be able to reach Plex. Router port forwarding is not needed.
%1$s is reachable and saved. You can select it over this VPN.
The speaker replied, but its description couldn\'t be read.
Can\'t reach that speaker on port 1400. Check its IP and that the VPN routes to your home network.
Enter the speaker\'s home IP address, for example 192.168.1.53.
Use the speaker\'s private home-network IP address.
That address didn\'t identify itself as a Sonos speaker.
Couldn\'t find Sonos. Check your home-network connection.
Offline files play on this phone. Turn off offline mode and connect to Plex to use Sonos.
Sent %1$s to %2$s. Sonos plays this track; phone controls stay local.
No speakers found. Add a speaker by IP to use it over a routed VPN.
%1$s returned no speakers. Saved addresses are still available.
Speakers found via %1$s. Playback still needs a VPN route to your home network.
%1$s is unavailable. Saved speakers and direct IP connections still work.
Home speaker directory disconnected. Saved speakers are unchanged.
Home speaker directory token saved securely.
Applies to playback on this phone only. Downloads, files on Plex and Sonos playback are never changed.
Turn off to hear the recording exactly as it is.
Voice boost is not supported on this device.
The equaliser is not supported on this device.
Sound processing is not supported on this device.
Switch to another member of your Plex Home. Playback stops, and history, downloads and progress shown are that user\'s own.
This Plex account has no other Home users.
Enter this user\'s four-digit Plex Home PIN. It is sent to Plex once and not saved.
Plex did not accept that PIN. Nothing was changed.
Home users need a Plex sign-in. Link with Plex first; a manual connection keeps working.
Connect to a server before switching users.
%1$s cannot reach the server in use. Nothing was changed.
Switch failed: %1$s. You are still signed in as before.
Plex did not return a sign-in for that user.
Every address Plex advertises for this server, best first: local before remote before relay, secure before insecure. Testing never changes the saved connection.
Manual connection: only the saved address can be tested.
Plex no longer lists the saved address for this account; only it is shown.
Could not ask Plex for this server\'s addresses (%1$s); only the saved address is shown.
In use: the first reachable address in preference order.
In use: it answered first when the app connected. A preferred address is also reachable now.
In use, but not answering now. Your saved connection is kept.
Preferred: the first reachable address in preference order.
Showing the last saved copy; Plex could not be reached.
This library has no Plex collections yet.
No saved collections. Collections opened while online are kept for offline browsing.
Authors with two or more books in this library appear here.
This collection is no longer on Plex.
This collection has no audiobooks from this library.
None of the unfinished books here are downloaded.
Add books from a book\'s page to keep them here, in the order you want to read them.
Saved on this phone for this account and server.

resources.string: See how much space downloads, cached artwork and saved Plex details use, and clear the caches.
Clearing a cache never removes downloaded audio, your Plex sign-in, listening history or progress waiting to reach Plex.
Verified offline audio and covers. Remove downloads one at a time from the Downloads tab.
Plex covers kept so the library draws quickly. They download again when needed.
The new limit applies the next time %1$s starts.
Covers download again as you browse. Downloads, your Plex sign-in and listening history are kept.
Library lists, track lists and playlists kept for a quick start. They reload from Plex when you browse.
Library details reload from Plex the next time you browse. Downloads, your Plex sign-in, listening history and unsent progress are kept.
Some cached files could not be cleared. Try again.

Counted from playing time on this phone for this account and server, by calendar day in the phone\'s time zone when you listened. Seeking and playback speed do not change it. Days are kept for %1$s; a day joins a streak after %2$s of listening.
Days were recorded in more than one time zone: %1$s.
No listening history for this account on this server yet. Books you play on this phone appear here.
This phone forgets its saved position for this book and marks it reset. Plex metadata and the position on Plex and other devices are not changed; nothing is sent to Plex.
This book is loaded in the player. Stop it or play something else before starting it over.

Removes saved positions, completed and reset marks and listening time for this account on this server, on this phone only. Plex metadata, Plex progress and downloads are not changed, and nothing is sent to Plex. Anything still playing is recorded again as you listen.
